description: MB7: `agent.messages` lists a thread's rows for a loop — scope from the loop row, never a flag. An ask and its reply are one thread (the reply links `resultOf` the ask), and the delivery pair (`deliveredAt`, `deliveredToStepId`) appears only once the boundary has drained the row. There is NO authoring method: a person steers the loop (S39); agents file rows through the ask tool behind the policy gate (MB1).

messages.body: what framing should the intro take?
